intro.title: Prevention is better than cure
intro.description: Technology is not infallible. My job is to anticipate problems, reduce risks, and respond with judgment when something happens. I offer remote service for Colombia, Latin America, Spain, USA, Canada, and more.

guarantee.title: Responsible work, no overload or abandonment
guarantee.description: I work with a limited number of projects. I prefer to properly fulfill each commitment, maintain clear communication, and accompany each project from start to finish without delegating to third parties.

audit.title: Technical Audit
audit.description: Deep review of the real state of your website to detect vulnerabilities, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities (WPO).
items: Requires access to the technical environment.
audit.note: * The audit cost is discounted from the final service if you decide to perform the technical work with me.

consulting.title: Strategic Consulting
consulting.description: 1-on-1 orientation and diagnosis session where we solve specific doubts, evaluate ideas, and define the architecture or path to follow.
consulting.note: Subsequent sessions have a cost based on time dedication and the scope of the requirement.
